text: Are these episodes brief, lasting less than a minute, and do they occur specifically when you roll over in bed or look up? I want to rule out Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you experience nausea or vomiting during these episodes, and do you notice any imbalance or difficulty walking when the vertigo subsides? I also need to know if you have any neck pain or history of cervical spine issues.
